faqs.q: How does Cashifin calculate the price quote for my device?
faqs.a: Our dynamic pricing engine appraises your device instantly based on its model brand, standard market depreciation rate, demand multipliers, and your answers to the diagnostics checks.

faqs.q: What happens if my device condition does not match my appraisal answers?
faqs.a: During doorstep pickup, our representative performs a physical inspection. If the condition matches, you receive the full quoted amount instantly. If minor differences are found, a revised value is computed on-site.

faqs.q: Is it safe to sell my phone on Cashifin?
faqs.a: Yes! We guarantee complete data security. Every device bought undergoes standard diagnostic wipe scripts to securely destroy any local cache, private files, and logins permanently.
